notes.title: 1.2.9 Colour Change Patch
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26034149/aa34271259893580aef6a5511a8f407e2b3997f1.png

In preparation for the upcoming FREE Outpost DLC, Lectrovolt II is being updated with a Character Colour Change Patch! (1.2.9)

I addition to some common bug fixes that have been reported, players now have the option to change the colour of the Lectrovolt unit at the Title Screen, from the original Electric Blue to a Deep Red, Forest Green, Vibrant Pink and Lamplight Yellow! Also, a special unlockable BLACKLIGHT LECTROVOLT upon completing the game the first time.

SMALL PRINT:
The Options screen bugs have been sorted out, and some frame rate issues have been fixed. There are some small freezes as the game loads certain areas of the map that I can't change without a ground-up rebuild, apologies for that, and the save files are integrated into the actual game and have been altered, so all updates will result in saves erased.
